## Overview

Follow-up to #58877 to fix Triton kernels for sm110. Note this does not change the default kernel selection for sm110.

## Claims

Fixes https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/61374 and supersedes #61387

## Validation

Verified by the original author @janbernloehr

## Details

Apply the same fix from sm120 to sm110.

---

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [ ] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

nodes.body:
@wtdcode Tested your branch at c7e9e69aee7c on Jetson AGX Thor (SM110), using GPT-OSS-120B MXFP4, TP=1: Revision | Selection | Actual backend | Result -- | -- | -- | -- Parent 2c74fd187 | Default | TRITON | Original matmul_ogs compilation failure Parent 2c74fd187 | `--moe-backend triton` | TRITON | Same failure Your branch c7e9e69a | Default | MARLIN | Pass; GSM8K 0.4621 ± 0.0436 Your branch c7e9e69a | `--moe-backend triton` | TRITON | Pass; GSM8K 0.4318 ± 0.0433

The comparison used the same pinned base image, precompiled binaries, and dependency versions, including PyTorch 2.14.0 and Triton 3.8.0. The controls reproduced Cannot make_shape_compatible: incompatible dimensions at index 0: 128 and 64; both candidate configurations completed evaluation.

This supports your approach of fixing Triton while retaining MARLIN as the default on SM110.

One performance observation: the evaluation request loop took 18:24 with Triton versus 13:22 with MARLIN. The two CUDA-graph captures took 105/93 seconds versus 14/14 seconds. These were single runs on separate Thor nodes, not a controlled throughput benchmark.

GSM8K used five-shot, flexible-extract exact match on a 10% subset (132 questions); the reported ± values are standard errors. These results establish startup and evaluation completion, but don’t establish accuracy equivalence.

-@pytest.mark.parametrize("sm12x", [True, False])
-def test_gpt_oss_priority_prefers_marlin_on_sm12x(
-    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, sm12x: bool
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("family", "marlin_first"), [(None, False), (100, False), (110, True), (120, True)]
+)
+def test_gpt_oss_priority_triton_vs_marlin(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, family: int | None, marlin_first: bool
 ):
-    """SM12x runs the OAI Triton kernels at small tiles only, so MARLIN must
-    stay the default there while TRITON remains selectable explicitly."""
+    """MARLIN stays the default on SM110 (unbenchmarked) and SM12x (small tiles
+    only) while TRITON remains selectable explicitly."""
     monkeypatch.setattr(mxfp4_oracle.current_platform, "is_cuda", lambda: True)
     monkeypatch.setattr(
         mxfp4_oracle.current_platform,
         "is_device_capability_family",
-        lambda family: sm12x and family == 120,
+        lambda f: f == family,
     )
     order = mxfp4_oracle._get_priority_backends_for_gpt_oss()
     triton_first = order.index(Mxfp4MoeBackend.TRITON) < order.index(
         Mxfp4MoeBackend.MARLIN
     )
-    assert triton_first is not sm12x
+    assert triton_first is not marlin_first
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("family", [110, 120])
+def test_swizzle_mxfp4_pins_epilogue_subtile(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, family: int
+):
+    """Without epilogue_subtile=1 the opt_flags heuristic picks a subtiled
+    epilogue with SWAP_XW, which fails to compile in matmul_ogs (#61374)."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        mxfp4_utils.current_platform, "is_device_capability", lambda cap: False
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        mxfp4_utils.current_platform,
+        "is_device_capability_family",
+        lambda f: f == family,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(opt_flags, "_opt_flags_constraints", {})
+    w = torch.zeros(1, 256, 128, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    scale = torch.zeros(1, 256, 8, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    mxfp4_utils._swizzle_mxfp4(w, scale)
+    assert opt_flags._opt_flags_constraints == {
+        "is_persistent": True,
+        "epilogue_subtile": 1,
+    }
 
 
 def test_unit_shuffle():

@@ -46,10 +46,11 @@ def _triton_kernel_moe_supports_current_device() -> bool:
     p = current_platform
     if p.is_cuda():
         cap = p.get_device_capability()
-        # Hopper SM90, datacenter Blackwell SM100/103 and consumer Blackwell
-        # SM120/121. SM12x needs the opt-flag constraints applied by
-        # `_swizzle_mxfp4` and `_constrain_sm12x_block_m` to fit its 99KB of
-        # shared memory; it is still ordered after MARLIN by the selector.
+        # Hopper SM90, datacenter Blackwell SM100/103, Jetson Thor SM110 and
+        # consumer Blackwell SM120/121. SM110 and SM12x need the opt-flag
+        # constraints applied by `_swizzle_mxfp4` (SM12x also
+        # `_constrain_sm12x_block_m` to fit its 99KB of shared memory); both
+        # are still ordered after MARLIN by the selector.
         return cap is not None and (9, 0) <= (cap.major, cap.minor) < (13, 0)
     if p.is_rocm():
         from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx1x, on_gfx9

@@ -421,10 +421,14 @@ def _get_priority_backends_for_gpt_oss() -> list[Mxfp4MoeBackend]:
         Mxfp4MoeBackend.CPU,
         Mxfp4MoeBackend.EMULATION,
     ]
-    if current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(120):
-        # Consumer Blackwell: the OAI Triton kernels run but their 99KB shared
-        # memory budget caps them at small tiles, so MARLIN prefills ~10%
-        # faster at equal decode throughput. Keep TRITON as an opt-in.
+    if current_platform.is_cuda() and (
+        current_platform.is_device_capability_family(110)
+        or current_platform.is_device_capability_family(120)
+    ):
+        # Keep TRITON as an opt-in. Consumer Blackwell: the OAI Triton kernels
+        # run but their 99KB shared memory budget caps them at small tiles, so
+        # MARLIN prefills ~10% faster at equal decode throughput. Jetson Thor
+        # (SM110): MARLIN stays the default as it has not been benchmarked.
         _AVAILABLE_BACKENDS.remove(Mxfp4MoeBackend.TRITON)
         _AVAILABLE_BACKENDS.insert(
             _AVAILABLE_BACKENDS.index(Mxfp4MoeBackend.BATCHED_MARLIN) + 1,

@@ -137,14 +137,15 @@ def _swizzle_mxfp4(quant_tensor, scale, num_warps=8):
                 K = scale.shape[-1]
                 pad_k = -K % 4
                 scale = torch.nn.functional.pad(scale, (0, pad_k))
-        elif current_platform.is_device_capability_family(
-            100
-        ) or current_platform.is_device_capability_family(120):
-            # Native MXFP (cap >= 10.0) requires the persistent kernel. On
-            # SM12x, epilogue_subtile=1 also keeps the heuristic away from a
-            # triton_kernels 3.5.1 codegen bug (SWAP_XW with a subtiled
-            # epilogue); block_m is pinned per call in
-            # gpt_oss_triton_kernels_moe to fit the 99KB shared memory.
+        elif any(
+            current_platform.is_device_capability_family(family)
+            for family in (100, 110, 120)
+        ):
+            # Native MXFP (cap >= 10.0) requires the persistent kernel, and
+            # epilogue_subtile=1 keeps the heuristic away from a triton_kernels
+            # 3.5.1 codegen bug (SWAP_XW with a subtiled epilogue) that SM110
+            # and SM12x otherwise hit. On SM12x, block_m is also pinned per
+            # call in gpt_oss_triton_kernels_moe to fit the 99KB shared memory.
             constraints = {
                 "is_persistent": True,
                 "epilogue_subtile": 1,
